purpose.summary: This is a subroutine ('FTN' suffix suggests 'function') for calculating patient co-payment amounts for hospital admissions (nyuin) in the JMA ORCA medical receipt software system. It handles complex Japanese health insurance billing calculations including various insurance combinations, room charges, high-cost medical expense thresholds, and special cases such as disaster/self-pay admissions.

verdict.notes: The file is decoded with latin-1 but the Japanese comments are likely EUC-JP or Shift-JIS, causing mojibake in the displayed text. The program is clearly part of the well-known JMA ORCA (Open Receipt Computer by Association) system, a real-world Japanese medical billing platform. The absence of COMP-3 is notable for financial code but consistent with some GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL practices. Only the first 16000 characters were shown; the PROCEDURE DIVISION content is not visible but inferred from mechanical indicators.
